title: Beef Stew with a Twist
description: A hearty german-inspired beef stew with a mild, spiced twist. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: ukrainian spices
ingredients.notes: such as garlic, dill, or paprika

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced carrot and cubed potato to the pot. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste (if using), allspice, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine, then return the beef to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the ukrainian spices and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
